title: Dedicated intake gate: throughput SLAs, autoscale templates, and provisioning playbook
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Goal: Design an intake gating process and a set of standard artifacts that let sales/solutions/SEs submit dedicated capacity requests with: (1) a validated throughput SLA profile, (2) an autoscaling template that maps anticipated traffic shapes to scaling policies and burst buffers, and (3) a provisioning playbook for capacity ops to approve and allocate GPU pools.

Scope: This ticket covers the intake form fields, a judgement rubric for SLA bands, a small library of autoscale templates (steady, spiky-burst, multimodal), and an operator playbook for approving/denying/triaging requests. It does NOT include UI changes to Console; Console integration will be a follow-up.

Why: We frequently see variability in reservation requests: missing data for traffic shape, inconsistent SLA expectations, and repeated manual follow-ups with engineering to size pools. That increases onboarding latency and leads to overprovisioning. Creating a repeatable intake + template set will reduce time-to-allocate, improve utilization, and let us guarantee throughput SLOs more reliably.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form spec (Google Doc) with required fields for workload profile: QPS/peak, average token length, percent tail (95/99), prefix cache hit expectations, KV cache use, acceptable p99 latency
SLA band rubric created (Bronze/Silver/Gold) with clear throughput and p99 latency commitments and an explanation of tradeoffs (batching/cost/latency)
Three autoscale templates implemented as YAML examples: steady, spiky-burst, multimodal; each maps traffic signals to target batch sizes, min/max pool sizes, and burst buffer rules
Operator provisioning playbook drafted with approval checklist, gating criteria, rollback steps, and example communication templates for customers
Success metric definitions and dashboard queries added to docs: time-to-allocate, allocation error rate, first-week utilization vs requested, SLA compliance rate
Handoff notes for Console/Onboarding team with required API surfaces and integration points (routes, webhooks, and RBAC scopes)
